founder.headline: L. Moody, *DNP*, APRN-C
founder.body:
Dr. Lissette Moody is a board-certified nurse practitioner and the founder of Premier Wellness Telehealth. With approximately 14 years of experience, she has cared for adults across a variety of clinical settings, including primary care, preventive health, chronic condition support, and comprehensive wellness assessments.

She founded the practice to give adults convenient access to thoughtful, personalized care — without the rushed experience that can happen in traditional healthcare settings.

testimonial.body: Dr. Moody takes the time to listen. In her care I never felt rushed — I felt heard.
